subject: RECORD clause
notes: Re-verdicted by kb/Work PB322 F (w1012h), closing the SD arm PB1276/PB1277 left open. cite.py --check 13.18.43.4 'If format 1 is implied, integer-1 shall be the record size of the largest record description entry in this file description entry.' -> OK §13.18.43.4 5) a). A RECORD-clause-less SD is the implied Format 1 of D-FRA (iv) exactly like an FD, so every record of its sort file is the largest description's size: RELEASE of a shorter record description sends the whole record area (BindRelease sizes the released range by the area, SortEmitter.EmitRelease sends SentRecordImage), and SORT GIVING writes AAAAZZZZZZ, not AAAA plus spaces.
